quote_context: Kraken XRP/USD and OKX XRP-USDT are different quote instruments. USD/USDT conversion, fees and execution costs were not captured.

limitations: No provider event timestamp is present; retrieval time is not event time.

comparisons.treatment: Descriptive only. Do not interpret as arbitrage or relative value because quote currencies, timestamps, fees, conversion and executable depth are not normalized.

prior_kraken_retrieval_vintage.interpretation: Two retrieval-vintage observations only. Kraken supplied no provider event timestamp in either response; this is not a validated event-time return or a model feature.

hypotheses.claim: The decline reflects broad cross-asset risk-off pressure.
hypotheses.required_disconfirming_test: Synchronize BTC, broad crypto index, equity futures, dollar and Treasury-yield observations to the same event window before attributing XRP movement.

hypotheses.claim: Venue-specific order flow or liquidity changes contributed to the observed price differences.
hypotheses.required_disconfirming_test: Capture synchronized multi-level books and trades from multiple independent venues; Level-1 ticker sizes are insufficient.

hypotheses.claim: The raw Kraken/OKX difference is primarily affected by quote-currency and timestamp mismatch.

reasons: Kraken has no provider event timestamp.
OKX provider timestamp is 951.534 seconds old, exceeding the 300-second live-feature threshold.
Only Level-1 quotes are available; no synchronized multi-level depth or trades.
USD and USDT are not normalized.
The two Kraken snapshots are retrieval-vintage observations, not verified event-time returns.
